{"type": "update", "filePath": "/Users/dhruva/src/dhruvasagar/rails-upgrade-with-claude/app/jobs/cart_cleanup_job.rb", "content": "class CartCleanupJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :maintenance

  # Clears cart items for carts that haven't been updated in 30 days
  def perform
    stale_carts = Cart.joins(:cart_items)
                      .where("cart_items.updated_at < ?", 30.days.ago)
                      .distinct

    stale_carts.find_each do |cart|
      cart.cart_items.destroy_all
      Rails.logger.info "Cleared stale cart ##{cart.id} for user ##{cart.user_id}"
    end
